# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 1944413083, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> a reader at a lamp-lit desk with an open book whose chapters float out as separate glowing pages, a magnifying glass, cozy library at night, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
